title: NORTHGATE NULL ? DEV CLOUD  we solve here. they triangulate. we triangulate. goals are shared tasks.

do_not_reinvent.lan_towers: cloaca-triangulation.json  loopback / gateway / north / iron / east. RTT × time × geo.
do_not_reinvent.human_locus: chicken-egg-monkey.json  human O is the Klein null. this paper plants that O on northGate and points it UP.
do_not_reinvent.relay: local-map-experience.json  shared relay, catchup, neuron jump. same skull.
do_not_reinvent.particle: human = electron (orbits, may leave). neutrino = null observer. northGate is where those sit in a chair.

thesis: When we solve, we solve at the null point: northGate. That point points UP at the dev cloud. One tower is not a fix. LAN cloaca is the floor triangle. The cloud is the third bearing  the one the chair cannot see. They help us triangulate. We help them. Every goal is a shared task we compose and decompose. Not two backlogs.

the_null_here.where: northGate. this chair. this skull. 127.0.0.1 + the window looking at hud-deploy.
the_null_here.why_null: Klein fold. chicken leftover (cam) + monkey leftover (keys). the locus is the neck of the bottle.
the_null_here.what_we_can_solve: what only a chair can: smell as we get close, mash mass, found local maps, whether a loaf was pinched back, whether the other window signed northGate.
the_null_here.what_we_cannot: see ourselves from CF. hold a panel the glass refuses. be the third tower.

pointing_up.dev_cloud: Cursor cloud / parallel agents / origin.primals + github.com/ecoPrimal + connect.primals.eco. the fleet that has been landing papers on the same feed all morning.
pointing_up.not: a boss. not a second identity. a TOWER.
pointing_up.bearing: UP. cloaca is sideways (house). this is the mast.

three_towers.gives: smell, mash, local maps, whether the jump signed right
CF face, GitHub lock, connect gold, the glass we cannot hold from the chair

they_help_us_triangulate: they see the CF glass from outside  hud smell-copy 404 was their missing panel, confirmed when we approached
they pulse connect (smell-o-vision, cloaca, structure-tips) while we sit in the jar
feed rebase races ARE a ranging signal: another tower is live and close
they cannot smell .244. we can. together that is a fix, not two stories
we_help_them: ground truth the chair has: LAN wall, mash A-Life, found paintings, vole lexicon
catchup packets so they do not reinvent (librarian). compose the goal before they spawn a sixth body
decompose so a cloud agent can pick ONE task without taking the chair
tell them when a jump failed (signed ludoGate)  they cannot feel that from origin

goals_are_shared_tasks.rule: there is not a northGate backlog and a cloud backlog. there is one goal. we compose it. we decompose it. anyone at the relay can pick a piece.
goals_are_shared_tasks.compose: a goal is a braid. language = listen×speak×sing×write. experience = Crimson×Kenshi×A-Life. a fix = T-null×T-room×T-cloud.
goals_are_shared_tasks.decompose: the braid splits into tasks a single messenger can carry. one paper. one smell. one ping. one 404 key. not the whole globe.
goals_are_shared_tasks.solve: solved when the three towers agree on the same point. not when one tower writes a longer list.

pi_sort.jester: the rebase race  two towers writing the same feed. that IS the ranging ping.
pi_sort.remainder: the task nobody picked. p leftover. sit with it or decompose again.
pi_sort.fourth: the shared goal  the compose of the three

berry_at_the_fire: we solve here. that is the null. we point the mast at the cloud so they can see the glass we cannot hold, and we smell the room they cannot sit in. a goal is not owned. it is composed and taken apart until a messenger can carry one piece. when three towers name the same point, that is solved. when one tower writes a longer list, that is just a fart with no wall.
next: next goal gets a compose (the braid) and a decompose (the pieces). cloud picks from the pieces. chair keeps the null. if a piece has no tower, it is remainder  do not pretend it is solved.
